capabilities: Open a dangling-links panel via command or ribbon icon
Group dangling links by file or folder
Navigate to each link occurrence on click
extras: The README states the plugin is "only lightly maintained" and points readers to an unnamed alternative; it also requires Obsidian v0.9.15 or later.
intentEvidence: you might find this alternative suits your needs better
motivation: The author notes dangling links "may be typos or ... links you intended to make a note for but forgot to get to" and that having a list of them is nice to work with.
problem: Obsidian lets links to nonexistent notes exist silently, so typos or links to never-written notes are easy to miss without a dedicated list.
summary: Sidebar view that lists dangling links—links in notes that point to nothing in the vault—with grouping, collapsing and navigation to each occurrence.
